Name: Smooth Camera
Author: xzcute
Description:
[center][size=4][img]https://i.imgur.com/3h6rmHb.png[/img][/size][/center]
[center][url=https://smapi.io][img]https://img.shields.io/badge/SMAPI-4.5.0+-brightgreen.svg[/img][/url] [url=https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc-sa/4.0][img]https://img.shields.io/badge/License-CC%20BY--NC--SA%204.0-lightgrey.svg[/img][/url] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098][img]https://img.shields.io/badge/GMCM-Compatible-purple.svg[/img][/url] [img]https://img.shields.io/badge/Platform-Windows%20|%20macOS%20|%20Linux-lightgrey.svg[/img][/center]
[center][size=4]Replaces the default snappy camera with a smooth, weighted follow system.[/size][/center]
[center][size=4]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/zDYNRgf.gif[/img][/size][/center]
[center][size=4][b]Before / After[/b] [/size][/center]

[heading][size=5]Features[/size][/heading]
[list]
[*][size=4][b]Smooth follow:[/b] Uses exponential decay so the camera eases into position rather than jumping to it.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Configurable speed:[/b] Dial it anywhere from "stays glued to the player" to "drifts in slowly after you move."[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Separate X/Y Smoothing:[/b] Set independent follow speeds for horizontal and vertical movement.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Dead Zone:[/b] Camera doesn't move during small movements near the screen center.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Cutscene handling:[/b] Optionally pauses smoothing during cutscenes, and snaps back instantly on map warps so the camera doesn't fly across the screen.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Bobber Follow:[/b] Camera follows the fishing bobber during a cast.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Impact Reactions:[/b] Camera shakes on nearby tree falls and explosions.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Interior toggle:[/b] Turn smoothing off for small rooms where it tends to hurt orientation more than help it.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]GMCM support:[/b] All settings are available in-game through [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url].[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Languages[/b]:  English, Russian and French included.[/size][/*]
[/list]
[heading][size=5]Installation[/size][/heading]
[list]
[*][size=4]Install [/size][url=https://smapi.io][size=4]SMAPI[/size][/url][size=4] 4.5.0 or newer.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Download Smooth Camera and extract the folder into your [/size][i][size=4]Stardew Valley/Mods[/size][/i][size=4] directory.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4](Optional) Install [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098][size=4]Generic Mod Config Menu[/size][/url][size=4] if you want to change settings without editing the config file by hand.[/size][/*]
[/list]
[heading][size=5]Configuration[/size][/heading]
[list]
[*][size=4][b]Enabled[/b] - Master on/off switch. Default: On.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Smoothing Speed[/b] - Higher values follow more tightly, lower values add more lag behind the player. Default: 10.0.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Separate X/Y Smoothing[/b] - Control horizontal and vertical camera smoothing at separate speeds.  Default: Off [/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Horizontal Smoothing Speed[/b] - Camera follow speed on the X axis. Default: 10[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Vertical Smoothing Speed[/b] - Camera follow speed on the Y axis. Default: 10 [/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Enable Dead Zone - Keeps the camera still while the player stays within a small area near the screen center. Default: On [/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Dead Zone Radius[/b] - Radius in pixels before the camera starts following the player again.  Default: 16 [/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Toggle Key[/b] - Keybind to flip the mod on and off while playing. Default: K.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Enable in Cutscenes[/b] - Applies smoothing during cutscenes. Default: Off.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Safe Cutscene Mode[/b] - Adds safety fallbacks for custom and heavily scripted cutscenes. Recommended to keep on. Only works if Enable in Cutscenes is enabled. Default: On.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Enable in Interiors[/b] - Applies smoothing inside buildings and small rooms. Default: On.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Enable in Planning Mode[/b] - Applies smoothing in Build, Museum, and Animal Purchase screens. Default: Off.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Follow Bobber [/b]- Shifts the camera to the bobber while a cast is active. Returns to the player after a catch or cancel. Default: On.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Bobber Camera Bias[/b] - Camera position between the player and the bobber.  Default: 0.5[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Camera Impact Reactions [/b]- Camera shakes when a nearby tree falls or an explosion goes off. Default: On. [/size][/*]
[/list]
[heading][size=5]Compatibility[/size][/heading]
[list]
[*][size=4]Stardew Valley 1.6 and up.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Works in split-screen multiplayer.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Compatible with Reshade and similar visual tools.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Plays fine alongside Zoom Level and other camera-altering mods.[/size][/*]
[/list]
